decisions: D-63 — CAPABILITY_SCHEMA_VERSION takes 4: the published payload gained the dispositions map.
D-72 — serialize_leaf is the only producer of a payload leaf and of that leaf's entry.
R-17/D-97 — landed against the committed coupled baseline plus this allowlist; the baseline is re-captured at the phase boundary, never here.
R-20 — S9 is a pure stage, so its declared count is 0 for moved numbers; every occurrence below is a schema addition and none is a moved value.

change.one_sentence: Every payload that publishes a number now publishes a parallel dispositions map beside it, keyed by leaf path, saying whether a rule produced that number.
change.wire_shape: MEASURED and STRUCTURAL_ZERO leaves are unchanged bare numbers; a WITHHELD leaf is absent from the payload while its entry remains, carrying the receipts.

qualifying_population.why: R-20's second half. The count is a property of the coupled scenario set rather than of the change: the map is one new leaf per captured combat receipt, so the population is exactly the scenarios in scripts/golden_coupled_baseline.json that carry a combat block. That set is committed and was read from it.
qualifying_population.rule: One leaf per scenario carrying a combat block; leaf_report treats the whole map as one leaf rather than recursing into it, so no scenario contributes more than one.

measured.pair_golden: zero diffs — the map is coupled-path output and golden enters through pipeline.run_fight (D-93).
measured.transition: absent_to_value on every one — a block that did not exist at capture, not a number that changed

oracle_pass.why: R-19 asks an independent investigator to adjudicate between an old and a new value. Every occurrence below is absent_to_value on a newly published schema block: there is no old value to adjudicate and no arithmetic to reproduce from cached wiki text. The occurrences are declared here so the orchestrator's pass has its population and can record the same finding rather than discovering it.
oracle_pass.numeric_evidence: tests/test_payload_dispositions.py asserts the map's key set equals the payload's published quantities, both directions, against a live run — the non-golden numeric gate this slice cites (D-93).

landed_against.rule: R-17/R-32/D-97 — no baseline moves inside this commit

occurrences_outside_the_enumerated_popul.raised_by: An R-35 residue-sweep pass over the R-19 slice group, 2026-08-17, which read this file against the commit that reported its adjudication and returned the criterion NOT DISCHARGED.
occurrences_outside_the_enumerated_popul.what_the_reporting_commit_said: 21118e2's body opens: 'Twelve fresh Opus 5 investigators adjudicated the twelve occurrences the S9 allowlist (docs/receipts/expected-golden-diff-P4-S9-dispositions.json) enumerated in advance: the ten per-scenario combat/dispositions blocks and the two coupled-snapshot shape counters that moved with them.'
occurrences_outside_the_enumerated_popul.what_this_file_actually_enumerated: Ten. expected_qualifying_occurrences is ten, qualifying_population.size is ten, measured.coupled_golden_diffs_this_slice_adds is ten, and qualifying_occurrences lists exactly the ten per-scenario dispositions paths. The two snapshot shape counters are declared in this file -- under their own key beside the ten, as expected diff PATHS -- and they are counted in nothing here: not in the population, not in the expected count, not in the measurement. `git log -- docs/receipts/expected-golden-diff-P4-S9-dispositions.json` returns one commit, bf4a6d3, and it precedes 21118e2, so no widening ever happened: the population this slice declared in advance is the one it still declares.
occurrences_outside_the_enumerated_popul.the_two_that_landed_outside_it: The receipts filed for them are docs/receipts/oracle-S9-leaf10.json and docs/receipts/oracle-S9-leaf11.json.
occurrences_outside_the_enumerated_popul.what_R_20_says_about_that: R-20's second half makes an occurrence outside the enumerated population a stop, in exactly the way an over-count is a stop -- 'any occurrence outside it is an unexpected one and stops the slice exactly as an over-count would'. Two landed and the slice did not stop. They were absorbed by filing a receipt each, and the reporting commit then described all of them as pre-enumerated, which is the sentence that made the absorption invisible to a later reader.
occurrences_outside_the_enumerated_popul.why_this_is_a_record_and_not_a_repair: The remedy R-20 names is a declaration made BEFORE the edit. A count written today is read off a tree the edit already changed, which is the exact shape R-20's second half exists to forbid, and widening this file's population now would be that shape wearing the word 'correction'. Unreachable in both directions, so the honest disposition is a dated record -- the same disposition section 13.1 of the closing report gives the campaign's eight historical commits with no R-20 line.
occurrences_outside_the_enumerated_popul.what_bounds_the_acceptance: Three measurements, not three intentions. First, both occurrences are the coupled snapshot's own shape counters -- self-statistics of the artifact rather than values any rule computes -- and both oracles say so in their own text and explicitly decline to certify why the artifact changed. Second, both verdicts came back new_value_correct, so nothing was absorbed over a dissent and no S9 commit is reverted or amended on this account. Third, both paths were named in this file in advance, so neither was ever an unexplained diff to tests/test_coupled_golden_allowlist.py: what was missing is the count, not the declaration, and the gate that reads this file reads the paths.
occurrences_outside_the_enumerated_popul.what_this_does_not_claim: It does not claim the two occurrences were harmless because their oracles agreed -- the verdict is the adjudication and not the licence, and R-20's stop exists precisely so that a slice does not get to find out afterwards. It does not re-grade the R-35 criterion, which stands NOT DISCHARGED as the verifier rendered it. And it does not claim this is the only such absorption in the campaign; it is the one a sweep pass found.
